title: A log line parser
hints: `(?<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})` is one named group; `match.groups` holds them all (lesson 7.01).
`(?<level>INFO|WARN|ERROR)` allows only the three levels; `\[(?<source>\w+)\]` takes the source without the brackets.
requirements: One regular expression with named groups (`(?<level>...)`); a line that does not match returns `null`.
`summary(lines)` counts lines per level, skipping lines that do not match.
stretch: Use `matchAll` with the `g` and `m` flags to parse a whole multi-line string at once.
